license.summary: HPO vocabularies/annotation files are freely available; conditions: (1) acknowledge and cite the HPO Consortium; (2) publicly displayed HPO files must carry their date/version; (3) ontology content and its logical relationships must not be altered. This project uses the files unmodified, records versions+SHA256, and displays the credit line in generated documentation.
license.credit_line: This product uses the Human Phenotype Ontology (hp.obo data-version hp/releases/2026-09-01; phenotype.hpoa version 2026-09-02). Find out more at http://www.human-phenotype-ontology.org
license.caution: phenotype.hpoa aggregates OMIM- and Orphanet-derived annotations; downstream commercial use may require separate OMIM/Orphanet terms. This project uses the associations for non-commercial portfolio research only.

phenotype.hpoa.description: HPO annotations for rare diseases [8478: OMIM; 47: DECIPHER; 4357 ORPHANET]

alternatives_considered.MONDO: CC-BY 4.0 disease ontology; not needed this round because phenotype.hpoa already carries disease identifiers and names used for selection; may be added later for disease hierarchy.
alternatives_considered.medSpaCy: evaluated for context detection (ConText); deferred: adds heavy dependency chain for the same cue-window behaviour implemented transparently in clinforge.med_extract with documented cue lists.
